solution:
tmp starts as '[ hello ]+ hello, world!!_ hi'. The loop reads a separate lowercase string in that same order. On each iteration, char is the first character of the current tmp, so the test is True and replace(char, '', 1) removes exactly that character.
After the iterations for '[ hello ]+', tmp is ' hello, world!!_ hi'. After those for ' hello, ', it is 'world!!_ hi'. After those for 'world!!_ ', it is 'hi'. Removing 'h' leaves 'i', and removing 'i' leaves '', which is returned.
Final answer: ''
